name: PowerShell Execution and Firewall Tampering for Python Listener
root_cause: An elevated PowerShell process executed netsh.exe to create an inbound Windows Firewall rule allowing incoming TCP traffic to python.exe, following an intentional Security audit log clearance.

suspicious_processes: "C:\windows\system32\netsh.exe" advfirewall firewall add rule name=python.exe dir=in action=allow description=python.exe program=C:\users\wardog\appdata\local\programs\python\python39\python.exe enable=yes localport=any protocol=tcp remoteip=any
